cautions: No model generation, memorization or generalization test.
LPIPS uses scaled RGB, FFT uses raw grayscale; differences are not solely frequency versus perception.
Selected classes with only one image have no same-class nonmatching candidate.
Means and retrieval are descriptive; no independent-pair standard errors or confidence intervals.
Same epsilon is reused across t, and pure-noise control reuses those banks: conditions are dependent.
This run does not test differences between correlations or between metrics.
Compare retrieval/rank behavior, not absolute distance values across metrics.

fft.distance: RMS difference of log-power features within mask
fft.input: raw float tensors, no PNG conversion or clipping

lpips.high_noise_validity: exploratory; not validated as a noise-invariant metric

mantel.correction: Holm across all valid noisy AND pure-noise tests; clean identity control excluded

retrieval.directions: A->B and B->A separately; mean of both
retrieval.pure_noise_note: Matching IDs are arbitrary without an image signal
retrieval.tie_rule: uniform fractional credit among minima; atol=1e-10 rtol=1e-7
